title: HistoryCommand
responsibility: Registers Git history attach, status, reasons, prune, sync, build, and legacy report-import commands.

inputs.name: registerHistoryCommand.program
inputs.description: Commander program that receives the history command tree.

outputs.name: registerHistoryCommand
outputs.description: Returns the registered history command with attach, status, reasons, prune, fetch, push, sync, build, and import-reports subcommands; attach/status/reasons default their commit to HEAD and build defaults its limit to 2000.
